material_research_findings.finding: Ripple and Circle jointly announced on 2025-06-12 a partnership to bring native USDC to XRPL. Circle Mint and APIs support XRPL. Ripple stated it intended to use USDC alongside RLUSD in Ripple Payments. This supersedes the prior graph non-edge claiming no direct partnership.
limits: Product integration partnership; no equity, merger, joint ownership or exclusivity established.
Native USDC on XRPL does not prove every USDC transfer uses XRP as a bridge.

material_research_findings.finding: Coinbase Advanced Global Derivatives in eligible supported non-US regions lists XRP cross-collateral with 15% X:SM haircut and a dash in X:PM (not assumed zero). Coinbase Prime Global Derivatives for eligible US institutions lists USDC/BTC/ETH only and says cross-collateral is not enabled. Coinbase US Derivatives uses USD cash; USDC is indirect via optional auto-conversion. These are distinct product and jurisdictional regimes.
limits: No XRP collateral balances, customer counts or rebalancing volumes disclosed.

material_research_findings.finding: The letter references the March 2026 SEC/CFTC digital-commodity interpretation that lists XRP. Conditional staff no-action relief concerns specified CFM-to-Coinbase Bermuda-to-Deribit transfers for 30.7 customer foreign futures/options positions. The 120% cap is Regulation 30.7(c), not a separate letter-specific condition. The 100% net-liquidating-equity custody statement is a CFM factual-background representation, not a numbered condition or independent custody audit.
limits: Coinbase Prime's current public US collateral list still excludes XRP; actual XRP use is unverified.

material_research_findings.finding: Arc uses USDC for gas; SBI Group is in the founding-validator cohort; Coinbase is an exchange participant, not a validator. Circle's 98.8% agent-driven transaction-volume statement is global Agent Stack/x402 scope, not Arc-specific.
limits: Circle Agent Stack's 99.8% x402 transaction-value figure and agents.circle.com's 99.6% October agent-transaction-volume figure are different metrics/windows and must not be averaged.

material_research_findings.finding: SBIC is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. The 'ChatGPT SBIC' phrase is best explained by its June 12-13 2025 AI/ML training for investee companies (ChatGPT on day one, Copilot on day two). It is distinct from SBI Holdings/SBI Group; no XRP or Circle relationship established.

Permission Coin ASK is the best-supported candidate. Its official contract directory lists LayerZero OFT contracts on Base and Polygon and Stargate support; no XRPL contract is listed and no direct XRP integration is established.

No reliable source has yet resolved the exact originating phrase. Barrot now distinguishes cash-funded XRP purchases, in-kind contributions, debt proceeds, optional facilities, collateralized inventory, credit advanced, automatic rebalancing sales and net external capital.
sources: Current capital-and-collateral policy in run13 ledger
